description.value:
Your special martial arts training leads you to master the use of certain weapons. This path also includes instruction in the deft strokes of calligraphy or painting. You gain the following benefits.

Kensei Weapons. Choose two weapons that do not have the special or heavy properties. You are proficient in these weapons and they count as monk weapons for you.

Whenever you make an unarmed attack, you can attack with one of these weapons instead if you are currently wielding them.

You can choose two additional weapons when you reach the levels 6, 11, and 17 in this class, following the same criteria.

Way of the Brush. You gain Proficiency with your choice of calligrapher's supplies or painter's supplies.
